exclusivaTexto: There are moments in life that are special, but sharing them with those we love makes them unforgettable. That's why we want you to be part of this small and very intimate celebration of the love we share.
teInvitamos: We invite you to our wedding
historia1: Our story began on April 24, 2018, almost without imagining that this day would mark the beginning of the most beautiful journey of our lives.
historia2: On September 17, 2022, facing the sea and with the sound of the waves as a witness, we had already said "yes" to a life together, promising each other love, patience, respect, and complicity.
historia3: We chose this significant date to take the next step by celebrating our eighth anniversary, with the certainty of having found in each other our safe place, our refuge, our home.
historia4: We want only those who have truly been an essential part of our path, who have laughed with us, held us, and witnessed our history individually and as a couple, to join us in this special moment.
historia5: Having you by our side will make this extraordinary day even more meaningful for us.
bodaNoTradicional: Our wedding will not be a traditional celebration; it will be an experience meant to be lived together, step by step. We will meet in Yaruquí, to start the afternoon in a warm and relaxed atmosphere.
outfit1: The first outfit will be casual, ideal for sharing laughs, karaoke, billiards, drinks, and snacks while the sun accompanies us.
outfit2: If the weather permits and you wish, you can change into a second outfit: a swimsuit, to enjoy the pool and continue celebrating under the open sky.
outfit3: And when the night arrives, we invite you to transform the energy and wear your best formal attire to witness our ceremony and the party that follows.
noBlanco: No white, ivory, bone, pearl or red. No jeans.
gracias: Thank you for being part of our story
trasladosTexto: For your convenience, we will have a bus service departing from Yaruquí to the south of Quito at 12:00 AM (midnight) on the day of the event.
transporteGuardadoSi: ✓ We have registered that you need transportation back. Thank you!
transporteGuardadoNo: ✓ Preference saved: you don't need transportation.
cancionBailar: What song is a must for dancing?
cancionBailarDesc: Share the track that cannot be missing on the dance floor tonight. We will add it to the party's setlist.
cancionCena: What would you listen to during dinner?
cancionCenaDesc: Share a song you'd like to listen to during dinner. We'll create the perfect atmosphere with your suggestions.
regalosTexto: Your presence is our best gift. If you wish to give us something else, you can help us build our next dreams and our honeymoon.
concepto: Please include your name in the transfer concept. Thank you!
paypalTexto: You can send your gift directly through PayPal. Please include your name in the message.
